channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by high-severity flaws in the Microsoft ecosystem, with extensive remote code execution risks in Windows desktop components, SQL Server databases, and Azure cloud infrastructure. Critical attack vectors include heap buffer overflows, use-after-free errors, and unsafe deserialization that threaten endpoint stability, database integrity, and containerized workloads. Additional significant concerns affect network devices such as DNS and DHCP servers, industrial control systems from manufacturers like Siemens and Advantech, and web platforms vulnerable to SQL injection and request smuggling.
